column1: # Open-weights policies of the paper's open batch, served locally by vLLM (harness/policy_serve.sh).
#   slug | Hugging Face repo | revision (commit hash) | tensor-parallel | max new tokens per turn | contrast tags
# The slug is the served and recorded model name. Tensor-parallel is 1 for models up to
# 12B (one GPU) and 2 above. Max new tokens: 2048 for models that answer with the call
# directly; 8192 for models that write their reasoning first (a cut generation parses as
# no call). Image budget, episode deadline, temperature, seed and every dependency
# endpoint are the run's, shared with the frontier run.
# Revisions: byte-identical to the checkpoint copies the paper runs loaded (config,
# tokenizer, processor, template and index files compared, shard sizes compared), except:
#   qwen3.5-9b, qwen3.8-27b: tokenizer.json differs only in JSON formatting (same content);
#   gemma-4-31b-it: the run copy also carried two extra template files
#     (chat_template_thinking_level.jinja and one hashed variant) that the serve does not load;
#   gemma-3-*: gated repositories; file names and sizes match, contents not compared.
